components.css: .panel { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 24px; min-width: 0; } .padded { padding: 26px; } .panel-title { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .panel-title h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.035em; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary call to action with 44px touch target.
components.css: button.primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 15px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; } button.primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px #0002; } button.primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral button for filters, options, and auxiliary actions.
components.css: button.secondary { background: var(--surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 15px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; } button.secondary:hover { background: var(--bg); border-color: var(--muted); } button.secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

narrative.overview: scrobbl.rs merges the quiet authority of an archivist's catalog with the tactile clarity of an audiophile dashboard. Surfaces are tinted with the accent color via OKLab color-mix to guarantee organic harmony in any theme.
keyCharacteristics: Dynamic OKLab surface tinting with user accent

rules.name: The Dynamic Tinting Rule
rules.body: Never declare hardcoded neutral grays in component styling. Always use var(--surface), var(--surface-raised), var(--border), and var(--bg).

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards, panels, and widgets must never have ambient box-shadows when resting on the page. Depth is achieved via 1px border framing and surface contrast.

rules.name: The Balanced Headline Rule
rules.body: All h1, h2, and h3 headings enforce text-wrap: balance to eliminate typographic orphans.

dos: Do use var(--surface), var(--surface-raised), and var(--border) for widget containers.
Do terminate primary h1 headings with .
Do ensure all interactive buttons and inputs have at least min-height: 44px.
Do mirror widget geometries with SkeletonBlock placeholders during async loading.
donts: Don't add raw gray hex codes like #222 or #eee.
Don't add ambient box-shadows to stationary dashboard panels or cards.
Don't import external Google Fonts or CDN stylesheets; use local Material Icons Outlined.
Don't use spinning wheel loaders for widget data; use shimmer skeletons.
